leadText:
Tony's parents are characters of the day who appeared in Go, Go Gogoat!.

Tony's mother was first seen informing Officer Jenny that her son had run off. When and arrived, she explained that Tony was upset because it was his father's birthday, but his father would be unable to make it home from his work at the mountain observatory that night. As a result, Tony had run off to the observatory. Officer Jenny told her to stay in the city in case Tony returned.

Tony's father later appeared when everyone arrived at the observatory. Initially, he scolded his son for running away, but was happy to see that he was safe. Tony presented him with his present, a drawing of his father's favorite Pokémon constellation, . Now reunited, the family spent the night stargazing.
